mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_PRESS WHERE PRS_TYPE = '4' AND PRS_AUTH = 'ST'
AND PRS_COUNTRY = #{country}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_AD_LOG A
INNER JOIN WH_PRESS B ON A.PRS_ID = B.PRS_ID WHERE B.PRS_COUNTRY = #{country}
SELECT PRS_COUNTRY AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS VALUE FROM WH_PRESS WHERE PRS_TYPE = '4' GROUP BY PRS_COUNTRY

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATED_DATE, '%m월') AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS VALUE FROM WH_AD_LOG A
INNER JOIN WH_PRESS B ON A.PRS_ID = B.PRS_ID
WHERE A.CREATED_DATE >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
AND B.PRS_COUNTRY = #{country}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATED_DATE, '%Y-%m'), DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATED_DATE, '%m월') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATED_DATE, '%Y-%m') ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT A.MEM_ID) FROM WH_AD_LOG A
INNER JOIN WH_PRESS B ON A.PRS_ID = B.PRS_ID
WHERE A.CREATED_DATE >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
AND B.PRS_COUNTRY = #{country}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_PRESS WHERE PRS_ID = #{PRS_ID}

SELECT PRS_ID, PRS_NAME, PRS_AUTH, PRS_TYPE, APP_ID, PRS_USE_YN, PRS_COUNTRY FROM WH_PRESS WHERE (PRS_ID = #{PRS_ID} OR OWNER_EMAIL = #{PRS_ID}) AND PRS_PWD = CONCAT('*', UPPER(SHA1(UNHEX(SHA1(#{PRS_PWD}))))) AND PRS_USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE WH_PRESS SET PRS_USE_YN = #{TARGET_STATUS}, PRS_UPDATE_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE PRS_ID = #{PRS_ID}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WH_PRESS ( PRS_ID, PRS_PWD, PRS_NAME, PRS_COUNTRY, PRS_TYPE, PRS_AUTH, PRS_USE_YN, APP_ID, PRS_CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{PRS_ID}, CONCAT('*', UPPER(SHA1(UNHEX(SHA1(#{PRS_PWD}))))), #{PRS_NAME}, #{PRS_COUNTRY}, '1', 'LC', 'Y', #{PRS_ID}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(PRS_ID, 6) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1 FROM WH_PRESS WHERE PRS_ID LIKE 'star_%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WH_PRESS ( PRS_ID, PRS_PWD, PRS_NAME, PRS_COUNTRY, PRS_TYPE, PRS_AUTH, PRS_USE_YN, APP_ID, PRS_CREATE_DATE, IS_STAR, STORED_FILE_NM ) VALUES ( #{PRS_ID}, CONCAT('*', UPPER(SHA1(UNHEX(SHA1(#{PRS_PWD}))))), #{PRS_NAME}, IFNULL(NULLIF(#{PRS_COUNTRY}, ''), 'KR'), '4', 'ST', 'Y', #{PRS_ID}, NOW(), 'Y', IFNULL(NULLIF(#{STORED_FILE_NM}, ''), ELT(FLOOR(1 + RAND() * 3), CONCAT('https://api.dicebear.com/9.x/lorelei/svg?seed=', #{PRS_NAME}), CONCAT('https://api.dicebear.com/9.x/avataaars/svg?seed=', #{PRS_NAME}), CONCAT('https://api.dicebear.com/9.x/shapes/svg?seed=', #{PRS_NAME}) )) )
mapper.update: UPDATE WH_PRESS SET STORED_FILE_NM = ELT(FLOOR(1 + RAND() * 3), CONCAT('https://api.dicebear.com/9.x/lorelei/svg?seed=', PRS_NAME), CONCAT('https://api.dicebear.com/9.x/avataaars/svg?seed=', PRS_NAME), CONCAT('https://api.dicebear.com/9.x/shapes/svg?seed=', PRS_NAME) ) WHERE IS_STAR = 'Y' AND (STORED_FILE_NM IS NULL OR STORED_FILE_NM = '')
mapper.select:
SELECT PRS_ID, PRS_NAME, PRS_COUNTRY, PRS_USE_YN, PRS_CREATE_DATE AS CON_CREATE_DATE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_AD_LOG WHERE PRS_ID = A.PRS_ID) AS AD_VIEW_CNT, IFNULL(IS_POPULAR, 'N') AS IS_POPULAR,
-- [신규] 즐겨찾기(팔로워) 수 추가 IFNULL(FOLLOWER_CNT, 0) AS FOLLOWER_CNT
FROM WH_PRESS A WHERE PRS_TYPE = '4' AND PRS_AUTH = 'ST'
AND PRS_COUNTRY = #{country}
AND (PRS_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR PRS_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY IS_POPULAR DESC, PRS_CREATE_DATE DESC
LIMIT #{start}, #{length}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_PRESS WHERE PRS_COUNTRY = #{country} AND IS_POPULAR = 'Y' AND PRS_USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT A.CON_ID, A.CON_BODY, A.CREATED_DATE, A.IS_PINNED, B.PRS_NAME, B.STORED_FILE_NM as MEM_PICTURE,
-- (기존 하트 서브쿼리들...) (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STAR_CONTENT_LIKE WHERE CON_ID = A.CON_ID) AS HEART_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STAR_CONTENT_LIKE WHERE CON_ID = A.CON_ID AND MEM_ID = #{memId}) AS IS_LIKED,
D.THUMB_URL as image, D.MEDIA_URL, D.MEDIA_TYPE FROM WH_STAR_CONTENT A JOIN WH_PRESS B ON A.PRS_ID = B.PRS_ID JOIN STAR_CONTENT_MEDIA D ON A.CON_ID = D.CON_ID WHERE A.PRS_ID = #{starId} AND D.SORT_ORDER = 0 ORDER BY A.IS_PINNED DESC, A.CREATED_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE WH_STAR_CONTENT SET IS_PINNED = #{targetStatus}, PIN_LINK_TEXT1 = #{pinLinkText1}, PIN_LINK_URL1 = #{pinLinkUrl1}, PIN_LINK_TEXT2 = #{pinLinkText2}, PIN_LINK_URL2 = #{pinLinkUrl2} WHERE CON_ID = #{conId}
mapper.select:
SELECT B.PRS_ID, B.PRS_NAME, B.PRS_COUNTRY,
-- 전체 노출 수 COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_CNT,
-- OS별 노출 수 SUM(CASE WHEN A.OS = 'ANDROID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ANDROID_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN A.OS = 'IOS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IOS_CNT
FROM WH_AD_LOG A JOIN WH_PRESS B ON A.PRS_ID = B.PRS_ID WHERE A.ACTION = 'IMPRESSION'
AND DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATED_DATE, '%Y-%m') = #{targetMonth}
AND B.PRS_COUNTRY = #{country}
GROUP BY B.PRS_ID, B.PRS_NAME, B.PRS_COUNTRY ORDER BY TOTAL_CNT DESC
SELECT PRS_ID, POPULAR_ORDER, LIST_ORDER FROM WH_PRESS WHERE (POPULAR_ORDER > 0 OR LIST_ORDER > 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE WH_PRESS SET POPULAR_ORDER = CASE WHEN POPULAR_ORDER BETWEEN 12 AND 16 THEN 0 ELSE POPULAR_ORDER END, LIST_ORDER = CASE WHEN LIST_ORDER BETWEEN 9 AND 16 THEN 0 ELSE LIST_ORDER END
UPDATE WH_PRESS SET LIST_ORDER = 0 WHERE PRS_COUNTRY = #{country} AND LIST_ORDER BETWEEN 25 AND 32
UPDATE WH_PRESS SET POPULAR_ORDER = #{POPULAR_ORDER} WHERE PRS_ID = #{PRS_ID}
UPDATE WH_PRESS SET LIST_ORDER = #{LIST_ORDER} WHERE PRS_ID = #{PRS_ID}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, category, description, sns_link, collab_price, partner_price, email, status, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as created_at FROM ipo_requests WHERE status != 'hidden' ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, -- 대기중인 걸 가장 위로 created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_GUEST_BLACKLIST WHERE DEVICE_ID = #{deviceId}

SELECT R.REPORT_ID, R.TARGET_TYPE, R.TARGET_ID, R.REPORTER_DEVICE_ID, R.REASON, DATE_FORMAT(R.CREATED_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS REPORT_DATE, C.CONTENT AS REPORTED_CONTENT, C.NICKNAME AS REPORTED_NICKNAME, C.DEVICE_ID AS REPORTED_DEVICE_ID, C.STATUS AS COMMENT_STATUS FROM WH_GUEST_REPORT R LEFT JOIN WH_GUEST_COMMENT C ON R.TARGET_ID = C.CMT_ID AND R.TARGET_TYPE = 'COMMENT' WHERE C.STATUS = 'NORMAL' -- 🌟 조건 1: 아직 살아있는(NORMAL) 댓글만 보여줌 AND NOT EXISTS ( -- 🌟 조건 2: 이미 영구 차단(글로벌 블락)된 기기의 신고는 안 보여줌 SELECT 1 FROM WH_GUEST_BLOCK B WHERE B.DEVICE_ID = C.DEVICE_ID ) ORDER BY R.CREATED_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WH_ADMIN_CONTENT (ADMIN_ID, ADMIN_LEVEL, ADMIN_COUNTRY, CON_BODY, IMAGE_URL, CREATED_DATE) VALUES (#{ADMIN_ID}, #{ADMIN_LEVEL}, #{ADMIN_COUNTRY}, #{CON_BODY}, #{IMAGE_URL}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MESSAGES WHERE SENDER_TYPE = 'USER' AND IS_READ = 0

SELECT M.PAGE_ID, P.PRS_NAME, MAX(M.CREATED_AT) as LAST_MSG_TIME, (SELECT MESSAGE FROM MESSAGES WHERE PAGE_ID = M.PAGE_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 1) as LAST_MSG, SUM(CASE WHEN M.SENDER_TYPE = 'USER' AND M.IS_READ = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as UNREAD_COUNT FROM MESSAGES M JOIN WH_PRESS P ON M.PAGE_ID = P.PRS_ID GROUP BY M.PAGE_ID, P.PRS_NAME ORDER BY LAST_MSG_TIME DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_PRESS WHERE DATE(PRS_CREATE_DATE) = CURDATE()
AND PRS_COUNTRY = #{country}
mapper.update: UPDATE WH_PRESS SET PRS_PWD = CONCAT('*', UPPER(SHA1(UNHEX(SHA1('123'))))) WHERE PRS_ID LIKE 'star_%' AND (PRS_PWD IS NULL OR PRS_PWD = '' OR PRS_PWD = CONCAT('*', UPPER(SHA1(UNHEX(SHA1(''))))))
UPDATE WH_PRESS SET PRS_PWD = CONCAT('*', UPPER(SHA1(UNHEX(SHA1(#{PRS_PWD}))))), PRS_UPDATE_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE PRS_ID = #{PRS_ID} AND PRS_TYPE = '4' AND PRS_AUTH = 'ST'
mapper.select: SELECT CON_ID, CON_TITLE, CON_BODY, date_format(CON_UPDATE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS CON_UDATE FROM WH_CONTENT WHERE CON_TYPE = 7 ORDER BY CON_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE WH_CONTENT SET CON_TITLE = #{CON_TITLE}, CON_BODY = #{CON_BODY}, CON_UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE CON_ID = #{CON_ID} AND CON_TYPE = 7
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CON_ID), 0) + 1 AS CON_ID FROM WH_CONTENT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WH_CONTENT (CON_ID, PRS_ID, APP_ID, CON_TYPE, CON_CATEGORY, CON_TITLE, CON_BODY, CON_USE_YN, CON_PRIOT) VALUES (#{CON_ID}, #{PRS_ID}, #{APP_ID}, 7, 8, #{CON_TITLE}, #{CON_BODY}, '1', #{CON_ID})
mapper.select: SELECT V.VS_ID, V.CARD_KIND, V.RANK_TYPE, V.CATEGORY, V.LEFT_PRS_ID, V.RIGHT_PRS_ID, V.TITLE, V.IS_PINNED, V.PIN_ORDER, V.VISIBLE_YN, V.CREATED_DATE, L.PRS_NAME AS LEFT_NAME, R.PRS_NAME AS RIGHT_NAME FROM WH_VS_CARD V LEFT JOIN WH_PRESS L ON V.LEFT_PRS_ID = L.PRS_ID LEFT JOIN WH_PRESS R ON V.RIGHT_PRS_ID = R.PRS_ID WHERE V.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY V.IS_PINNED DESC, V.PIN_ORDER ASC, V.VS_ID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WH_VS_CARD ( CARD_KIND, LEFT_PRS_ID, RIGHT_PRS_ID, TITLE, IS_PINNED, PIN_ORDER, USE_YN, CREATED_DATE ) VALUES ( 'CUSTOM', #{leftPrsId}, #{rightPrsId}, #{title}, 'Y', IFNULL((SELECT MAX(W.PIN_ORDER) + 1 FROM WH_VS_CARD W WHERE W.USE_YN = 'Y'), 1), 'Y', NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE WH_VS_CARD SET USE_YN = 'N' WHERE VS_ID = #{vsId} AND CARD_KIND = 'CUSTOM'
mapper.select:
SELECT PRS_ID, PRS_NAME, PRS_COUNTRY, STAR_CATEGORY FROM WH_PRESS WHERE PRS_TYPE = '4' AND PRS_AUTH = 'ST' AND PRS_USE_YN = 'Y' AND IS_STAR = 'Y'
AND (PRS_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR PRS_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY IFNULL(FOLLOWER_CNT, 0) DESC, PRS_NAME ASC LIMIT 30

SELECT PRS_ID, PRS_NAME, PRS_COUNTRY, IFNULL(FOLLOWER_CNT, 0) AS FOLLOWER_CNT, PRS_BIO, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WH_STAR_CONTENT M WHERE M.PRS_ID = A.PRS_ID AND M.MDR_STATUS = 'APPROVED') AS HAS_CONTENT FROM WH_PRESS A WHERE PRS_TYPE = '4' AND PRS_AUTH = 'ST'
AND PRS_COUNTRY = #{country}
AND (PRS_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR PRS_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
AND (PRS_BIO IS NULL OR PRS_BIO = '')
AND PRS_BIO IS NOT NULL AND PRS_BIO != ''
ORDER BY HAS_CONTENT DESC, (PRS_BIO IS NULL OR PRS_BIO = '') DESC, FOLLOWER_CNT DESC, PRS_CREATE_DATE DESC
LIMIT #{start}, #{length}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_PRESS A WHERE PRS_TYPE = '4' AND PRS_AUTH = 'ST'
AND PRS_COUNTRY = #{country}
AND (PRS_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR PRS_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%'))
AND (PRS_BIO IS NULL OR PRS_BIO = '')
AND PRS_BIO IS NOT NULL AND PRS_BIO != ''

choose.when: SELECT D.MEDIA_URL FROM STAR_CONTENT_MEDIA D WHERE D.CON_ID = #{targetId} AND D.MEDIA_URL IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT D.THUMB_URL FROM STAR_CONTENT_MEDIA D WHERE D.CON_ID = #{targetId} AND D.THUMB_URL IS NOT NULL
choose.otherwise: SELECT C.CON_THUMNAIL FROM WH_CONTENT C WHERE C.CON_ID = #{targetId} AND C.CON_THUMNAIL IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT C.CON_ORIGIN_URL FROM WH_CONTENT C WHERE C.CON_ID = #{targetId} AND C.CON_ORIGIN_URL IS NOT NULL

mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_CONTENT WHERE MDR_STATUS = 'PENDING') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_STAR_CONTENT WHERE MDR_STATUS = 'PENDING') AS PENDING_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_CONTENT WHERE MDR_STATUS = 'REJECTED') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_STAR_CONTENT WHERE MDR_STATUS = 'REJECTED') AS REJECTED_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_CONTENT WHERE MDR_STATUS = 'HIDDEN') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_STAR_CONTENT WHERE MDR_STATUS = 'HIDDEN') AS HIDDEN_CNT, (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MIN(CON_CREATE_DATE), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') FROM WH_CONTENT WHERE MDR_STATUS = 'PENDING') AS OLDEST_MEMBER, (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MIN(CREATED_DATE), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') FROM WH_STAR_CONTENT WHERE MDR_STATUS = 'PENDING') AS OLDEST_STAR

choose.when: SELECT S.CON_ID, S.MDR_STATUS, D.MEDIA_URL AS IMAGE_URL FROM WH_STAR_CONTENT S LEFT JOIN STAR_CONTENT_MEDIA D ON S.CON_ID = D.CON_ID AND D.SORT_ORDER = 0 WHERE S.CON_ID = #{targetId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WH_MEDIA_MODERATION_LOG (TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, ACTION, REASON, ADMIN_ID, CREATED_DATE) VALUES (#{TARGET_TYPE}, #{TARGET_ID}, #{ACTION}, #{REASON}, #{ADMIN_ID}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT N.NEWS_ID, N.MESSAGE, N.TARGET_TYPE, N.TARGET_VALUE, N.SORT_ORDER, N.USE_YN, N.CREATED_DATE, N.UPDATED_DATE, P.PRS_NAME AS TARGET_STAR_NAME, V.CARD_KIND AS TARGET_VS_KIND, V.RANK_TYPE AS TARGET_VS_RANK_TYPE, V.CATEGORY AS TARGET_VS_CATEGORY, V.TITLE AS TARGET_VS_TITLE FROM WH_LIVE_NEWS N LEFT JOIN WH_PRESS P ON N.TARGET_TYPE = 'STAR' AND N.TARGET_VALUE = P.PRS_ID LEFT JOIN WH_VS_CARD V ON N.TARGET_TYPE = 'VS' AND N.TARGET_VALUE = CAST(V.VS_ID AS CHAR) WHERE N.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY N.SORT_ORDER ASC, N.NEWS_ID ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_PRESS WHERE PRS_ID = #{prsId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_VS_CARD WHERE VS_ID = #{vsId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WH_LIVE_NEWS ( MESSAGE, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_VALUE, SORT_ORDER, USE_YN, DEL_YN, CREATED_DATE ) VALUES ( #{message}, #{targetType}, #{targetValue}, IFNULL((SELECT MAX(W.SORT_ORDER) + 1 FROM WH_LIVE_NEWS W WHERE W.DEL_YN = 'N'), 1), #{useYn}, 'N', NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE WH_LIVE_NEWS SET MESSAGE = #{message}, TARGET_TYPE = #{targetType}, TARGET_VALUE = #{targetValue}, UPDATED_DATE = NOW() WHERE NEWS_ID = #{newsId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE WH_LIVE_NEWS SET USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPDATED_DATE = NOW() WHERE NEWS_ID = #{newsId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT L.LC_ID, L.CON_ID, L.DISPLAY_ORDER, L.IS_FEATURED, L.USE_YN, L.START_AT, L.END_AT, L.TITLE_OVERRIDE, L.CREATED_BY, L.CREATED_DATE, L.UPDATED_DATE, S.PRS_ID, S.CON_BODY, S.MDR_STATUS, S.CREATED_DATE AS CON_CREATED_DATE, P.PRS_NAME, P.STORED_FILE_NM, P.PRS_USE_YN, (SELECT D.MEDIA_TYPE FROM STAR_CONTENT_MEDIA D WHERE D.CON_ID = L.CON_ID ORDER BY D.SORT_ORDER LIMIT 1) AS MEDIA_TYPE, (SELECT D.MEDIA_URL FROM STAR_CONTENT_MEDIA D WHERE D.CON_ID = L.CON_ID ORDER BY D.SORT_ORDER LIMIT 1) AS MEDIA_URL, (SELECT IFNULL(D.THUMB_URL, IF(D.MEDIA_TYPE = 'VIDEO', NULL, D.MEDIA_URL)) FROM STAR_CONTENT_MEDIA D WHERE D.CON_ID = L.CON_ID ORDER BY D.SORT_ORDER LIMIT 1) AS THUMB_URL, CASE WHEN L.USE_YN = 'N' THEN 'HIDDEN' WHEN L.START_AT IS NOT NULL AND L.START_AT > NOW() THEN 'SCHEDULED' WHEN L.END_AT IS NOT NULL AND L.END_AT <= NOW() THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'LIVE' END AS STATUS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_LATEST_CONTENT_EVENT E WHERE E.LC_ID = L.LC_ID AND E.EVENT_TYPE = 'IMPRESSION') AS CNT_IMPRESSION, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_LATEST_CONTENT_EVENT E WHERE E.LC_ID = L.LC_ID AND E.EVENT_TYPE = 'PLAY') AS CNT_PLAY, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_LATEST_CONTENT_EVENT E WHERE E.LC_ID = L.LC_ID AND E.EVENT_TYPE = 'CLICK') AS CNT_CLICK, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_LATEST_CONTENT_EVENT E WHERE E.LC_ID = L.LC_ID AND E.EVENT_TYPE = 'PROFILE_CLICK') AS CNT_PROFILE_CLICK FROM WH_LATEST_CONTENT L LEFT JOIN WH_STAR_CONTENT S ON S.CON_ID = L.CON_ID LEFT JOIN WH_PRESS P ON P.PRS_ID = S.PRS_ID WHERE L.SECTION = #{section} AND L.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY L.DISPLAY_ORDER ASC, L.LC_ID ASC

SELECT S.CON_ID, S.PRS_ID, S.CON_BODY, S.CREATED_DATE, P.PRS_NAME, P.STORED_FILE_NM, D.MEDIA_TYPE, D.MEDIA_URL, IFNULL(D.THUMB_URL, IF(D.MEDIA_TYPE = 'VIDEO', NULL, D.MEDIA_URL)) AS THUMB_URL, IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM WH_LATEST_CONTENT L WHERE L.CON_ID = S.CON_ID AND L.SECTION = #{section} AND L.DEL_YN = 'N'), 'Y', 'N') AS ALREADY_YN FROM WH_STAR_CONTENT S JOIN WH_PRESS P ON P.PRS_ID = S.PRS_ID AND P.PRS_USE_YN = 'Y'
JOIN STAR_CONTENT_MEDIA D ON D.CON_ID = S.CON_ID AND D.MEDIA_TYPE = 'VIDEO' AND D.SORT_ORDER = (SELECT MIN(X.SORT_ORDER) FROM STAR_CONTENT_MEDIA X WHERE X.CON_ID = S.CON_ID AND X.MEDIA_TYPE = 'VIDEO')
JOIN STAR_CONTENT_MEDIA D ON D.CON_ID = S.CON_ID AND D.SORT_ORDER = (SELECT MIN(X.SORT_ORDER) FROM STAR_CONTENT_MEDIA X WHERE X.CON_ID = S.CON_ID)
WHERE S.MDR_STATUS = 'APPROVED'
AND (P.PRS_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR P.PRS_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND S.CREATED_DATE >= #{startDate}
AND S.CREATED_DATE < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY S.CREATED_DATE DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_LATEST_CONTENT WHERE CON_ID = #{conId} AND SECTION = #{section} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_STAR_CONTENT S JOIN STAR_CONTENT_MEDIA D ON D.CON_ID = S.CON_ID AND D.MEDIA_TYPE = 'VIDEO' WHERE S.CON_ID = #{conId} AND S.MDR_STATUS = 'APPROVED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_STAR_CONTENT S JOIN STAR_CONTENT_MEDIA D ON D.CON_ID = S.CON_ID WHERE S.CON_ID = #{conId} AND S.MDR_STATUS = 'APPROVED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WH_LATEST_CONTENT ( SECTION, CON_ID, DISPLAY_ORDER, IS_FEATURED, USE_YN, DEL_YN, START_AT, END_AT, TITLE_OVERRIDE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_DATE ) VALUES ( #{section}, #{conId}, IFNULL((SELECT MAX(W.DISPLAY_ORDER) + 1 FROM WH_LATEST_CONTENT W WHERE W.SECTION = #{section} AND W.DEL_YN = 'N'), 1), #{isFeatured}, #{useYn}, 'N', #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{titleOverride}, #{adminId}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE WH_LATEST_CONTENT SET IS_FEATURED = #{isFeatured}, START_AT = #{startAt}, END_AT = #{endAt}, TITLE_OVERRIDE = #{titleOverride}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPDATED_BY = #{adminId}, UPDATED_DATE = NOW() WHERE LC_ID = #{lcId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE WH_LATEST_CONTENT SET USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPDATED_BY = #{adminId}, UPDATED_DATE = NOW() WHERE LC_ID = #{lcId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE WH_LATEST_CONTENT SET DISPLAY_ORDER = #{displayOrder}, UPDATED_BY = #{adminId}, UPDATED_DATE = NOW() WHERE LC_ID = #{lcId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WH_LATEST_CONTENT_SETTING (ID, DISPLAY_COUNT, INTERVAL_SEC, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_DATE) VALUES (#{settingId}, #{displayCount}, #{intervalSec}, #{adminId}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE DISPLAY_COUNT = #{displayCount}, INTERVAL_SEC = #{intervalSec}, UPDATED_BY = #{adminId}, UPDATED_DATE = NOW()
INSERT INTO WH_LATEST_CONTENT_LOG (LC_ID, ACTION, ADMIN_ID, DETAIL, CREATED_DATE) VALUES (#{lcId}, #{action}, #{adminId}, #{detail}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT R.RPT_ID, R.MSG_ID, R.REASON, R.CONTENT_TYPE, R.CONTENT_SNAPSHOT, R.FILE_NM, R.THUMB_NM, R.STATUS, R.ADMIN_ID, R.ADMIN_MEMO, R.REPORTER_PRS_ID, IFNULL(RP.PRS_NAME, R.REPORTER_PRS_ID) AS REPORTER_NAME, R.TARGET_PRS_ID, IFNULL(TP.PRS_NAME, IFNULL(R.TARGET_PRS_NAME, R.TARGET_PRS_ID)) AS TARGET_NAME, -- 계정이 아예 사라졌으면 'X' (정지와 구분해서 표시한다) IFNULL(TP.PRS_USE_YN, 'X') AS TARGET_USE_YN, DATE_FORMAT(R.MSG_SEND_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS SEND_TEXT, DATE_FORMAT(R.CREATED_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS CREATED_TEXT, DATE_FORMAT(R.HANDLED_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS HANDLED_TEXT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_DM_REPORT A WHERE A.TARGET_PRS_ID = R.TARGET_PRS_ID) AS TARGET_REPORT_CNT FROM WH_DM_REPORT R LEFT JOIN WH_PRESS RP ON RP.PRS_ID = R.REPORTER_PRS_ID LEFT JOIN WH_PRESS TP ON TP.PRS_ID = R.TARGET_PRS_ID WHERE R.STATUS = #{status} ORDER BY R.CREATED_DATE DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OPEN_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'RESOLVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS RESOLVED_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DISMISSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DISMISSED_CNT FROM WH_DM_REPORT
SELECT RPT_ID, MSG_ID, REPORTER_PRS_ID, TARGET_PRS_ID, TARGET_PRS_NAME, REASON, CONTENT_TYPE, CONTENT_SNAPSHOT, FILE_NM, THUMB_NM, STATUS FROM WH_DM_REPORT WHERE RPT_ID = #{rptId}
mapper.update: UPDATE WH_DM_REPORT SET STATUS = #{status}, ADMIN_ID = #{adminId}, ADMIN_MEMO = #{memo}, HANDLED_DATE = NOW() WHERE RPT_ID = #{rptId} AND STATUS = #{fromStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT CONTACT_ID, CONTACT_TYPE, SENDER_NAME, SENDER_EMAIL, SUBJECT, MESSAGE_BODY, CLIENT_IP, STATUS, MAIL_SENT_YN, CREATED_DATE FROM WH_WEB_CONTACT ORDER BY (STATUS = 'NEW') DESC, CREATED_DATE DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WH_WEB_CONTACT

SELECT P.PRS_ID, P.PRS_NAME, P.STORED_FILE_NM, P.PRS_COUNTRY FROM WH_PRESS P WHERE P.PRS_USE_YN = 'Y' AND P.IS_STAR = 'Y'
